identificationModule.briefTitle: Neratinib Tablets in the Treatment of Advanced NSCLC With Rare EGFR Mutations
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single-arm, Open-label, Multicenter Phase II Clinical Study of Neratinib Tablets in the Treatment of Advanced NSCLC With Rare EGFR Mutations

descriptionModule.briefSummary: Single-arm, open-label, multicenter phase II clinical study
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Fourteen patients each had three mutation sites and 42 patients were co-enrolled，To evaluate the objective response rate (ORR) of neratinib Tablets in advanced NSCLC with rare EGFR mutations (including G719X, E709X in exon 18, S768I in exon 20 and L861Q in exon 21).

designInfo.interventionModelDescription: Fourteen patients each had three mutation sites and 42 patients were co-enrolled

armGroups.label: Arm1-Exon 18
armGroups.description: Exon 18 G719X, E709X, etc，Up to 14 patients will be enrolled in this group and will be treated with neratinib tablets in 28-day cycles，

armGroups.description: S768I in exon 20，Up to 14 patients will be enrolled in this group and will be treated with neratinib tablets in 28-day cycles，
